title: Village Stone Box Culvert 2m
description: S03 raised soil-road module with a small true stone-slab through channel. A 2 m road footprint matches existing rising-road high ends, with seven editable closed source parts and one static runtime mesh. Clear opening 0.34 x 0.24 m; its actual stone bottom is 0.06 m above the mounting plane. Overall depth includes 60 mm lining projections at both ends. See generate.py opening documentation for exact profile and placement. No water, navigation or structural performance guarantee.
